mechanism_of_action: TERN-501 is a thyroid hormone receptor-beta (THRβ) agonist; TERN-101 is a farnesoid X receptor agonist.
primary_endpoint: Relative change from baseline at week 12 in liver fat content by MRI-PDFF with TERN-501 monotherapy versus placebo.
efficacy_outcome: Week-12 MRI-PDFF least-squares mean change was −15.4% with TERN-501 1 mg, −27.5% with 3 mg (P = 0.0036), and −44.8% with 6 mg (P < 0.0001), versus −4.0% with placebo.
